title: Battery-waste recycling input identification: reproducibility software
description: Software for report-conditioned battery-waste input identification and deterministic assumption stresses. MIT covers original software only; embedded Eurostat/UBA/ILT data retain their source-specific conditions, including the Austria-declared CN8 commercial-use restriction. Basel raw records and Basel-derived numerical result/display files are not included. The study does not identify actual EV flow or facility receipts. See DATA_REUSE.md and the per-file release manifest. No blanket licence is granted over third-party data.
